editorial.headline: Alcohol Wholesale: Nationally Open, Still Open in Bali
editorial.standfirst: For distributors and sub-distributors of alcoholic drinks, this is a medium- and large-scale wholesale activity with full national foreign ownership and no Bali moratorium block.
editorial.body:
KBLI 46333 covers the wholesale trade of alcoholic beverages, including spirits, wine, malt beverages and beer. Its stated scope also names Alcoholic Beverage Distributors and Sub Distributors, giving the activity a clear commercial identity: it is the wholesale-distribution classification for these products. The focus is the trade itself and the distributor role through which that trade is conducted.

The record opens this activity to two operating scales: Menengah and Besar. That matters because the classification is framed around businesses working at those named scales, rather than as a catch-all label for every form of alcohol-related commerce. A prospective registrant should therefore understand the activity through the two roles expressly identified—distributor or sub-distributor—and the medium or large scale at which the record makes it available.

Nationally, the PMA status is TERBUKA, with a maximum foreign ownership level of 100%. In plain English, the activity is open to foreign investment and can be wholly foreign-owned at the national level. The cited basis is Perpres 10/2021 and 49/2021. There is no partial foreign-ownership ceiling to work around here: the recorded national limit is full foreign ownership.

Bali does not reverse that national position. The provincial moratorium blocks PMA registration for Low and Medium-Low risk KBLI activities, island-wide and permanently. This activity is not blocked: its Bali status is OK_or_HIGHER_RISK, and at the Besar scale its OSS risk is recorded as Medium-High/High. A foreign investor can therefore register this activity in Bali under the record’s stated PMA position. For this activity, national foreign-ownership access and Bali eligibility point in the same direction.
